# routeros_ip_kid_control (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_ip_kid_control" "control" {
  name     = "example"
  disabled = true
  fri      = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Kid Control profile.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `fri` (String) Time of day when internet access is allowed on Friday, e.g. `11:00:00-22:00:00`.
- `mon` (String) Time of day when internet access is allowed on Monday, e.g. `11:00:00-22:00:00`.
- `rate_limit` (String) Maximum data rate available to the devices of this profile, e.g. `3M`.
- `sat` (String) Time of day when internet access is allowed on Saturday, e.g. `11:00:00-22:00:00`.
- `sun` (String) Time of day when internet access is allowed on Sunday, e.g. `11:00:00-22:00:00`.
- `thu` (String) Time of day when internet access is allowed on Thursday, e.g. `11:00:00-22:00:00`.
- `tue` (String) Time of day when internet access is allowed on Tuesday, e.g. `11:00:00-22:00:00`.
- `tur_fri` (String) Time Unlimited Rate window on Friday: the period during which `rate_limit` is not applied. It takes precedence over `rate_limit`.
- `tur_mon` (String) Time Unlimited Rate window on Monday: the period during which `rate_limit` is not applied. It takes precedence over `rate_limit`.
- `tur_sat` (String) Time Unlimited Rate window on Saturday: the period during which `rate_limit` is not applied. It takes precedence over `rate_limit`.
- `tur_sun` (String) Time Unlimited Rate window on Sunday: the period during which `rate_limit` is not applied. It takes precedence over `rate_limit`.
- `tur_thu` (String) Time Unlimited Rate window on Thursday: the period during which `rate_limit` is not applied. It takes precedence over `rate_limit`.
- `tur_tue` (String) Time Unlimited Rate window on Tuesday: the period during which `rate_limit` is not applied. It takes precedence over `rate_limit`.
- `tur_wed` (String) Time Unlimited Rate window on Wednesday: the period during which `rate_limit` is not applied. It takes precedence over `rate_limit`.
- `wed` (String) Time of day when internet access is allowed on Wednesday, e.g. `11:00:00-22:00:00`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell

#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/ip/kid-control get [print show-ids]]
```
